modules.description: List of server modules to load; each enables specific functionality (e.g., compression, directory listing)

document_root.description: Base directory from which to serve files

bind_address.description: IP address the server binds to; use '127.0.0.1' for local-only access

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the main lighttpd process

error_log.description: Path to the error log file

access_log.description: Path to the access log file

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections the server will accept

event_handler.description: Event handler backend; choose based on OS support (e.g., 'poll', 'select', 'linux-sysepoll')

network_backend.description: Network I/O backend (e.g., 'write', 'writev', 'sendfile'); 'sendfile' best for static files on Linux

mimetypes.description: Mapping of file extensions to MIME types

dir_listing.description: Enable or disable automatic directory listing when no index file exists

compress_cache_dir.description: Directory to store compressed content caches

compress_filetypes.description: MIME types eligible for on-the-fly compression (gzip)

vhosts.description: List of virtual hosts; each has a domain pattern and document root

domain.description: Domain pattern (case-insensitive regex) to match Host header

root.description: Document root specific to this virtual host

log_request_header.description: Log full incoming request headers (debugging use only)

log_response_header.description: Log full outgoing response headers (debugging use only)

log_timeout_requests.description: Log requests that time out (helpful for diagnosing slow clients)

errorlog_use_syslog.description: Send logs to syslog instead of files

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS on a separate socket (requires `ssl.pemfile`)

ssl_bind.description: IP address to bind for HTTPS traffic

ssl_pemfile.description: Path to combined cert+key PEM file (must be readable by lighttpd user)

ssl_cipher_list.description: Allowed TLS cipher suites; leave empty to use defaults

fastcgi_enabled.description: Enable FastCGI support for dynamic content (e.g., PHP via PHP-FPM)

fastcgi_socket.description: Unix socket path for PHP-FPM or other FastCGI backend

fastcgi_bin_path.description: Path to FastCGI binary (fallback when socket is unavailable)

fastcgi_max_procs.description: Maximum number of FastCGI processes to spawn

static_exclude_extensions.description: Extensions that should bypass static-file handling (processed by other handlers)

index_files.description: List of filenames to look for as directory index (in order)

errorfile_prefix.description: Prefix path for custom error pages; lighttpd appends error code (e.g., 404.html)
